title: Can Large Language Model Agents Learn by Watching Tutorial Videos?
abstract: arXiv:2611.01460v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Humans continuously acquire knowledge from carefully crafted materials such as books and tutorial videos, carrying that understanding into future tasks. Millions of such instructional videos are uploaded online every day, yet LLM agents remain unable to exploit this ever-expanding wealth of human teaching. Their capabilities are frozen after training, while parameter updates at scale remain prohibitively expensive. This raises the central question: can LLM agents learn from this vast instructional resource without parameter updates? We introduce Tutorial Agentic Learning (TAL), a nonparametric continual-learning paradigm that consolidates tutorial videos into a persistent, structured tutorialbook memory through a two-stage adversarial process that harvests hard, video-grounded questions and uses them to refine the memory. translated_title: 大型语言模型智能体能通过观看教程视频学习吗？
translated_abstract: 人类能够持续地从精心制作的材料（如书籍和教程视频）中获取知识，并将这些理解运用到未来的任务中。每天都有数百万条此类教学视频上传到网上，然而大型语言模型（LLM）智能体仍然无法利用这一不断增长的人类教学资源。它们的能力在训练完成后便被冻结，而大规模的参数更新成本又过于高昂。这引出了一个核心问题：LLM智能体能否在不进行参数更新的情况下，从这一庞大的教学资源中学习？我们提出了教程智能体学习，这是一种非参数化的持续学习范式，它通过一个两阶段对抗过程将教程视频整合为持久、结构化的“教程书”记忆：该过程首先挖掘以视频为依据的高难度问题，再利用这些问题来完善记忆。在推理阶段，TAL通过目录（TOC）树进行检索，将检索过程直接与模型的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出教程智能体学习（TAL）这一非参数化持续学习范式，通过两阶段对抗过程将教程视频整合为结构化的“教程书”记忆并借助目录树检索，使LLM智能体无需参数更新即可像人类一样从海量教程视频中持续学习。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Tutorial Agentic Learning (TAL), a nonparametric continual-learning paradigm that consolidates tutorial videos into a persistent, structured tutorialbook memory via a two-stage adversarial process with Table-of-Contents-based retrieval, enabling LLM agents to learn from vast instructional videos without parameter updates.
